nodes.label: project.json / project_spec.template.json
nodes.rationale: Pipeline validates the project first and stops with named errors such as SCIENTIFIC_SPEC_MISSING.

nodes.label: Agent A1: MOF Topology Selector
nodes.rationale: AI agent selects appropriate MOF structures (topologies) from the text input.

nodes.label: Agent A2: QUBO Hamiltonian Constructor
nodes.rationale: AI agent constructs the QUBO hamiltonian for linkers' arrangement evaluation.

nodes.label: Agent A3: Physical Correctness Checker
nodes.rationale: AI agent checks physical correctness and compares to known results from papers.

nodes.label: Agent A4: QUBO Hamiltonian Adjuster
nodes.rationale: AI agent adjusts the previous QUBO hamiltonian choice if wrong candidates were provided.

nodes.label: Ground State Evaluation Stage
nodes.rationale: Ground state energy is computed for the top 5 best arrangement candidates, limiting expensive electronic-structure work to a short list.

nodes.label: QUBO Stage (QAOA solve)
nodes.rationale: QUBO is solved using the QAOA algorithm with both classical and quantum methods.

nodes.label: Text Input Stage (MOF modeling characteristics)
nodes.rationale: User supplies MOF modeling characteristics such as number of atoms and types of atoms.

nodes.label: Topology Search Stage
nodes.rationale: Most promising topologies are selected using an ML potential, pruning the search space cheaply before quantum steps.

nodes.label: New QuMOF Pipeline Diagram
nodes.rationale: Diagram of the agentic MOF discovery pipeline: text input -> topology search (ML potential) -> QUBO solved via QAOA -> ground state evaluation (classical DFT / quantum VQE+SQD) -> confirmation against literature, with an optimisation feedback loop (A4) back to QUBO hamiltonian construction.

nodes.label: Optimisation Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Closes the loop from confirmation back to QUBO hamiltonian construction so wrong candidates trigger a revised hamiltonian choice.

nodes.label: Orbit canonicalization, dedup and cross-graph pooling
nodes.norm_label: orbit canonicalization, dedup and cross-graph pooling
nodes.rationale: Key prefixed by topology_id; no A/B interchange; keep top five orbits per graph incl. ties; deterministic tie-break recording degeneracy.

nodes.label: Correction modes (none, constant, topology_dependent)
nodes.rationale: Artificial corrections test bookkeeping: constant leaves ranking unchanged; topology_dependent flips the winner from prism6 to ring12.

nodes.label: Synthetic ground-truth energy formula
nodes.rationale: E = offset - 0.020*unlike_d1 + 0.006*unlike_d2 (+0.015*BBB_paths in higher_order); per-graph offsets must be retained for cross-topology comparison.

nodes.label: prism6 (hexagonal prism graph)

nodes.label: ring12 (12-site cycle graph)
nodes.rationale: 924 arrangements, 50 orbits, base minimum -0.120 eV at alternating 010101010101.

nodes.rationale: Abstract graphs with known answers test the software path only; they do not validate synthesis, stability, ML potential, DFT accuracy or quantum advantage. Standard-library only.

nodes.label: Expensive-evaluation boundary (mock backend)
nodes.rationale: Never append corrected labels to base training set; failed calculations never become numeric energies; a bare active-space FCI/VQE energy is not an additive DFT correction without consistent subtraction and double-counting treatment.

nodes.label: A1: QUBO Hamiltonian Construction (NMAE)
nodes.rationale: Metric: constructed Hamiltonian spectrum error, NMAE (lower is better); random-design baseline ~0.17. Results: Qwen3.8 Max 0.034, Qwen3.8 Flash 0.062, DeepSeek V4 Pro 0.091, DeepSeek V4 Flash 0.079.

nodes.label: A2: QAOA QUBO Solution (correct output probability)
nodes.norm_label: a2: qaoa qubo solution (correct output probability)
nodes.rationale: Metric: QAOA correct output probability %, uniform-sampling baseline ~5%. Results: Qwen3.8 Max 34.5, Flash 31.1, DeepSeek V4 Pro 47.1, V4 Flash 47.5 (DeepSeek best here).

nodes.label: A2: QAOA Raw Energy Prediction (MAE)
nodes.rationale: Metric: energy MAE vs real potentials, eV/cell (lower is better); paper's Hamiltonian baseline ~0.46. Results: Qwen3.8 Max 0.507, Flash 0.442 (only one beating baseline), DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash 0.552.

nodes.label: A3: VQE Final Structure Prediction
nodes.rationale: Metric: final (best) structure error, eV/cell. Qwen3.8 Max and Flash both exact (0.00); DeepSeek V4 Pro and Flash 1.53.

nodes.label: Kang's [1] MUF-7 QUBO
nodes.rationale: Reference QUBO/Hamiltonian from citation [1] (Kang et al.) used as ground truth for evaluating LLM-constructed Hamiltonians.

nodes.label: MUF-7 LLM Benchmark Figure
nodes.rationale: Four-panel bar chart grouped into stages A1 (QUBO construction), A2 (QAOA solve + raw prediction) and A3 (VQE prediction), comparing four LLM agents on the MUF-7 metal-organic framework task. Qwen3.8 models win every panel; Qwen3.8 Max is best on A1/A2-raw, both Qwen models reach exact VQE results (0.00 eV/cell) while DeepSeek models err by 1.53 eV/cell.

nodes.label: Static provenance report (live literature NOT_RUN)
nodes.rationale: Do not compare synthetic energies with Kang, Cai or Fe-MOF-74 results; report MOFChecker, Zeo++, PXRD, NMR as skipped.

nodes.label: Kang et al. design benchmark (agents-design-bench)
nodes.rationale: Control run reproduces the paper's energy spectrum for all three materials (Spearman rho = 1.000); QAOA samples the experimental arrangement with median probability 0.25-0.49 vs 0.03-0.10 uniform random.

nodes.label: QuMOF pipeline
nodes.rationale: Automates Kang et al.'s hand-weighted QUBO approach end to end and grounds Hamiltonian weights in computed (DFT-fitted) energies instead of manual choice.

nodes.norm_label: kang, kim & kim 2025: quantum computing based design of multivariate porous materials

nodes.label: public vs reference benchmark inputs
nodes.rationale: A2 sees only public data (site graph, edge distances, linker lengths); experimental arrangement, paper VQE probability and kang_control are never sent to the model.

nodes.label: DFT-fitted QUBO Hamiltonian (step 3)
nodes.rationale: A2 picks model form (point/pair cluster features, QUBO or HUBO); code fits coefficients to DFT energies with grouped cross-validation; composition enforced by lambda (sum x_i - N_B)^2 penalty.

nodes.label: Topology from text (step 1)
nodes.rationale: Missing project fields are reported, never invented; ML potential screens out structurally incompatible topologies before expensive work.

nodes.label: Classical exact fixed-composition baseline (924 states)
nodes.rationale: Quantum execution disabled for acceptance; later QAOA must reproduce the classical objective and bit ordering.

nodes.label: Model M2 (M1 + all-B path triples, cubic)
nodes.norm_label: model m2 (m1 + all-b path triples, cubic)
nodes.rationale: Cubic: must stay higher-order for enumeration or be explicitly quadratized; silently dropping triplets is an error.

nodes.label: Agent A4 / A2 expansion (feedback loop)
nodes.rationale: If the energy model fails validation, run returns to step 3 with a new Hamiltonian; enabled by budget.allow_model_expansion.

nodes.label: Bounded active-learning loop (disabled initially)
nodes.rationale: Max three iterations; more labels cannot repair a missing interaction term, so allow explicit model-family expansion or return MODEL_INADEQUATE.

nodes.label: Deterministic Hamiltonian selection
nodes.rationale: Fit on training labels only, never hard-code winners; singular feature matrix is a failed candidate; LLM may propose families later but numerical validation stays authoritative.

nodes.label: Harness/oracle isolation boundary
nodes.rationale: harness/, reference_outputs/ and oracle source must not be exposed to learner or model selector.

nodes.label: Least-complex model with dev RMSE <= 1e-10 eV
nodes.norm_label: least-complex model with dev rmse <= 1e-10 ev
nodes.rationale: Near-zero tolerance only valid because labels are exact and noiseless; expected M1 for core_pairwise, M2 for higher_order.

nodes.label: QUBO compilation convention (upper triangle, 1.0 eV penalty)
nodes.norm_label: qubo compilation convention (upper triangle, 1.0 ev penalty)
nodes.rationale: Separate constant, linear terms, off-diagonal counted once; identity checked on all 4,096 strings; ranking energy excludes penalty and infeasible states are rejected.

nodes.label: Symmetry-orbit train/dev/holdout split
nodes.rationale: 30 train + 10 dev orbits per graph, rest withheld in harness/; no orbit crosses a split. Real datasets should use grouped CV plus separate test set.

nodes.label: finite_substitution_interaction_graph input mode
nodes.rationale: Bypasses CIF parsing; geometric screening reported as SKIPPED_NO_ATOMIC_GEOMETRY; do not fabricate CIFs.

nodes.label: Fixture integration instructions for coding agent
nodes.norm_label: fixture integration instructions for coding agent

nodes.label: Limitations
nodes.rationale: Simulators and fake IBM devices only; checks on synthetic toys; unrun checks reported as SKIPPED_*, DISABLED_BY_CONFIG, NOT_RUN or INCOMPLETE, never as passed.

nodes.label: Results on MUF-7
nodes.rationale: Automated Hamiltonian approximates MUF-7 QUBO; QAOA reached lower pre-relaxation energies than literature hand-built Hamiltonians; VQE-driven minimisation reconstructs true minimal states.

nodes.label: Agent policy boundaries table
nodes.rationale: An LLM proposal enters the same validated configuration interface as a human proposal; acceptance remains numerical; fixture stays runnable with agents off.

nodes.label: Fixture adapter into existing interfaces
nodes.rationale: Preserve existing architecture; record provenance SYNTHETIC; never rename graphs as physical nets; all runtime LLM features disabled.

nodes.label: Agents make judgement calls only (schema-validated)
nodes.rationale: All numbers come from code; every agent answer is validated against a strict JSON schema; three LLM requests per run plus at most one repair/A4 request.

nodes.label: Deterministic agent-free mode (qumof run)
nodes.rationale: Agents are optional; the project file fixes topologies and models so runs are reproducible without any LLM.

nodes.label: BDC / 2-amino-BDC linkers (1:1)
nodes.rationale: Requires even number of Zn4O units for exact 1:1; amino orientation convention must be fixed or added as variables.

nodes.label: Physical case recipe: MOF-5 BDC/amino-BDC
nodes.rationale: Recipe, not executable data; single topology tests arrangement handling not topology competition; closed-shell Zn(II) is a convenient start, not a strong-correlation demo.

nodes.norm_label: optional extras (agents, mlip, topology, qpu, aiida, gpu)
nodes.rationale: Package imports without extras; each optional component loads lazily. pyscf-dispersion lacks Apple-silicon wheels.
